title: Google Explains Why AI Tool Refuses to Name 2020 Election Winner

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Google has provided a response to reports that its conversational AI tool prevents users from identifying the winner of the 2020 U.S. presidential election. While the tool provides results for various other election cycles, including Donald Trump's victories in 2016 and 2024, it blocks responses to queries regarding the 2020 race.

The restriction was documented by users who noted that changing only the year in a query for election results triggered the block specifically for the 2020 outcome. The limitation on the AI tool follows assertions by Trump that Google CEO Sundar Pichai will follow his directions.
